name: HA Switches
author: Stefan
description: Switch Home Assistant devices (chiller, air, dust collector, lights) from ncSender, with their live on/off state. With the integration's webhook URL the buttons talk to Home Assistant directly, so they work with the controller off or a job paused; without it they send a comment line like (HA switch.shop_lights ON) through the controller. Needs the ha-ncsender integration (v0.5.0b2+) with the device allowed in its Configure screen.
